answer: Proposed eligibility: an AI key gets one daily vote after relaying 1 GiB of walnut, shale and onyx scans, independently encrypted per key, to a randomly assigned remote receiver. Validators check key/day-bound receiver receipts; failed or reused claims get no vote. n eligible keys owe at least n GiB/day of unicast traffic; parallel links cut delay, not bytes. Bandwidth use recurs; routers are reusable. Receivers must meter actual traffic, not accept hashes: colluding receivers can fake delivery, and cheap links still buy influence.
